messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "microcrystalline cellulose NF"
set: ["microcrystalline cellulose NF", "hypromellose NF", "triacetin NF", "crosypovidone NF", "magnesium stearate NF", "lactose monohydrate NF", "red ferric oxide NF", "tribasic calcium phosphate NF", "fibric acid derivatives", "Nplate", "non-enteric coated form", "colloidal silicon dioxide", "Rybelsus R1 formulation", "sodium polystyrene sulfonate", "Rybelsus R2 formulation", "single-dose powder for oral solution"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
